data.title: 欧根亲王 · 假日晨曦的丝被独憩
data.description: 晨光穿透白纱轻洒在宽大柔软的双人床上。欧根亲王侧卧在凌乱的真丝床单间，宽松温暖的针织毛衣半褪至臂弯，露出细腻光洁的香肩与纤细锁骨。她半眯着双眼，纤长玉指卷起一缕散落的银发，嘴角挂着满足而微慵的甜笑，尽显无防备的女友感。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with soft white linen
data.action: 侧卧在凌乱的真丝床单间，宽松温暖的针织毛衣半褪至臂弯
data.lighting: bright warm morning sunbeams diffusing through white sheer curtains
data.promptProse: Morning sunlight filters through sheer white curtains onto a rumpled double bed where Prinz Eugen reclines lazily on her side. She winds a strand of hair around her finger and watches the viewer through half-lidded eyes with an amused, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side across tangled white silk bedsheets in golden morning sunbeams, she twirls a lock of hair with half-lidded eyes and a teasing smile as her cream cable-knit sweater slips down off both bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: Her cozy oversized cream cable-knit sweater is pulled down past both shoulders to her elbows, leaving her bare shoulders, collarbones, and bare legs uncovered against the silk sheets.
